description: This file defines data structures, enums, and logic related to managing session data in an application, including session records, token statistics, session rows, and session loading mechanics with network requests and decoding. It appears to be a core part of handling session state within the app.

classes.name: GatewaySessionDefaultsRecord
classes.description: Stores default session configuration such as model and context tokens.

classes.name: GatewaySessionEntryRecord
classes.description: Represents an individual session's data received from the gateway.

classes.name: GatewaySessionsListResponse
classes.description: Encapsulates a response containing a list of session entries along with metadata.

classes.name: SessionTokenStats
classes.description: Tracks input, output, total tokens and provides related summaries.

classes.name: SessionRow
classes.description: Represents a session for UI, including metadata such as age, labels, flags, and session info.

classes.name: SessionKind
classes.description: Enum classifying session types: direct, group, global, or unknown.

classes.name: SessionDefaults
classes.description: Default session configuration such as model name and context tokens.

classes.name: ModelChoice
classes.description: Represents a choice of model with associated metadata.

classes.name: SessionLoadError
classes.description: Error types for session loading failures from network or decoding issues.

classes.name: SessionStoreSnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of session store containing path, defaults, and list of session rows.

classes.name: SessionLoader
classes.description: Contains static methods for asynchronously loading session data from a network source, with fallback defaults.

methods.name: loadSnapshot
methods.description: Asynchronously loads session data from a network source, decoding JSON into session objects and handling errors.

methods.name: loadRows
methods.description: Convenience method to load just session rows asynchronously.
